from astropy.modeling import models
from astropy.modeling.separable import _separable, _cstack, _compute_n_outputs

# Test case from the issue
cm = models.Linear1D(10) & models.Linear1D(5)

# Check what _separable returns for the nested model
nested_model = models.Pix2Sky_TAN() & cm

# Let's manually trace through _cstack
left = nested_model.left
right = nested_model.right

print("Left model (Pix2Sky_TAN):")
print("  n_outputs:", left.n_outputs)
print("  n_inputs:", left.n_inputs)
print()

print("Right model (cm - Linear1D & Linear1D):")
print("  n_outputs:", right.n_outputs)
print("  n_inputs:", right.n_inputs)
print()

# Compute noutp
noutp = _compute_n_outputs(left, right)
print("noutp:", noutp)
print()

# Get separable matrices
sepleft = _separable(left)
sepright = _separable(right)

print("sepleft shape:", sepleft.shape)
print("sepleft:")
print(sepleft)
print()

print("sepright shape:", sepright.shape)
print("sepright:")
print(sepright)
print()

# Now let's manually call _cstack
result = _cstack(left, right)
print("Result from _cstack:")
print(result)

import sys
sys.path.insert(0, '/testbed/astropy')

from astropy.modeling import models
from astropy.modeling.separable import _separable, _operators

# Test case from the issue
cm = models.Linear1D(10) & models.Linear1D(5)

# Check what _separable returns for the nested model
nested_model = models.Pix2Sky_TAN() & cm

print("nested_model.op:", nested_model.op)
print()

# Check the _operators dictionary
print("_operators keys:", _operators.keys())
print()

# Check the function for '&'
op_func = _operators[nested_model.op]
print("op_func:", op_func)
print()

# Now let's see what happens when we call _separable on the nested model
# This should call _separable on left and right, then apply the operator
sepleft = _separable(nested_model.left)
sepright = _separable(nested_model.right)

print("sepleft:")
print(sepleft)
print("sepleft shape:", sepleft.shape)
print()

print("sepright:")
print(sepright)
print("sepright shape:", sepright.shape)
print()

# Now call the operator
result = op_func(sepleft, sepright)
print("Result from op_func(sepleft, sepright):")
print(result)
